tools.name: about_involve_media
tools.description: Who Involve Media is: a one-person digital agency in Belleville, Ontario run by Stephen Osmond. Returns location, service area (Bay of Quinte and across Canada), hours, phone, contact page, booking link and social links. Use when someone asks who Involve Media is, where they are, what area they serve, or how to reach them.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Involve Media's services with short descriptions, what each includes, who it's a good fit for, and a link to its page: website design (two ways to pay: $0 down monthly, or upfront), online stores / e-commerce, landing pages, logo design, web hosting, Canadian web hosting, website migration, domain names, website copywriting, Google Business Profile, local SEO, AI search readiness (showing up in ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude answers), Google Ads, social media, email marketing, website maintenance, business email, CRM setup (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Jobber and others), business automation and integrations (Make.com, n8n, Zapier, QuickBooks, Stripe and more), GoHighLevel setup, ClickUp and project management setup (Asana, monday.com, Trello, Notion), AI setup (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, AI chatbots and AI receptionists), agent-ready MCP servers, and the free Local Business Checkup. Each service lists the tools it covers and answers to common questions. Use when someone asks what Involve Media does or whether it can help with something; pass `need` with their words to find the matching service.

category.description: Only this category: websites (Websites), get-found (Get found), ongoing-support (Ongoing support), automation-ai (Automation and AI), free (Free tools)

need.description: What the person needs or the tool they named, e.g. 'online store', 'Zapier', 'GoHighLevel', 'AI chatbot'

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Involve Media's published prices, in Canadian dollars before HST: websites ($0 down monthly plans or upfront builds), online stores, hosting, maintenance, Google Business Profile, local SEO, social media, email, domains, CRM and more. Use when someone asks what something costs. Quote prices exactly as given; never estimate a price that isn't listed (those are quoted after a short call).

service.description: A service id from list_services (e.g. website-design) or the person's words (e.g. 'online store')

tools.name: book_a_call
tools.description: The link to book a free 15-minute phone call with Stephen at Involve Media, plus the phone number. Use when someone wants to talk to Involve Media, get a quote, or get help with something the checkup found. This returns a link for the person to open; it does not book anything itself.

tools.name: run_checkup
tools.description: Runs Involve Media's free Local Business Checkup on a local business with a Google listing in Canada. Returns a score out of 100, four section scores (Google profile, reviews, website and SEO, AI answers), how it compares to nearby competitors, the top 3 fixes, and a link to the full report. Use when someone asks how their (or any) local business shows up on Google, in reviews, or in AI answers, or wants to know what to fix to get more customers online. Needs the business name and the town. If several businesses match, it returns candidates: ask the user which one and call again with its place_id. The speed and AI parts finish about a minute later; get_checkup returns the final result.

location.description: Town or city, e.g. Belleville, ON

trade.description: What the business does, e.g. plumber. Only needed if Google's category is vague; improves the competitor comparison.

place_id.description: Google place id from a previous candidates list, when the user has picked one

tools.name: get_checkup
tools.description: Gets the latest result of a Local Business Checkup by its report_id (from run_checkup), including the website speed test and AI answers test once they have finished. Use about a minute after run_checkup, or when the user asks for the final score. Can take up to a minute if a test is still running.
